First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{3}z}\frac{z}{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}\,dx\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}[{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{3}z}\frac{z}{{x}^{2}+{z}^{2}}\,dx]dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}{[z\cdot \frac{1}{z}\cdot \operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{z})]}_{x=0}^{x=\sqrt{3}z}\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}{[\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{z})]}_{x=0}^{x=\sqrt{3}z}\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}\operatorname{arctan}⁡\sqrt{3}-\operatorname{arctan}⁡0\,dz\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}\frac{\pi }{3}\,dz\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z,$ treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{y}\frac{\pi }{3}\,dz\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{y}\frac{\pi }{3}\,dz]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}[\frac{\pi }{3}{\int }_{0}^{y}dz]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{\pi }{3}[z]_{z=0}^{z=y}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{\pi }{3}\cdot y\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{\pi }{3}\,y\,dy & =\frac{\pi }{3}{[\frac{1}{2}{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=2} \\  & =\frac{\pi }{3}(2-0) \\  & =\frac{2\pi }{3}\end{aligned}
$$
